description.impact: Kalau folder .git ke-expose, seluruh source code + history + secret yang pernah ke-commit bisa diunduh.
description.detects: Request ke path /.git/config — tidak ada klien sah yang minta file ini.

description.impact: Bocornya access key + secret AWS = penyerang bisa ambil alih akun cloud (data, billing, infrastruktur).
description.detects: Request ke path /.aws/credentials — klien jinak tidak pernah memintanya.

description.attack: Penyerang menebak file konfigurasi rahasia (`.env`) atau backup-nya (`.env.bak`/`.env.local`/`.env.production`) yang nggak sengaja ke-publish ke web root.
description.impact: Bocornya seluruh secret aplikasi: kredensial DB, API key cloud, secret JWT, password mail SMTP — pintu masuk ke kompromi penuh.
description.detects: Request ke path `/.env` atau backup-variantnya (`.env.bak/.backup/.local/.production/.prod/.dev/.old/.orig/.save/.swp`) — tidak ada klien sah yang minta dotfile env config.

rules.msg: WEB Exposure - phpinfo() debug page probe [high]
rules.raw: alert http any any -> any any (msg:"WEB Exposure - phpinfo() debug page probe [high]"; flow:established,to_server; http.uri.raw; content:"phpinfo"; nocase; fast_pattern; pcre:"/\/(?:phpinfo(?:\.php|\.html)?|info\.php|test\.php|_profiler\/phpinfo|debug\.php)(?:[\?\#\s\x00]|$)/i"; classtype:attempted-recon; metadata: asset_category web-classic, owasp A05-Security-Misconfiguration, attack_target Server, mitre_tactic_id TA0007, mitre_tactic_name Discovery, mitre_technique_id T1083, mitre_technique_name File-and-Directory-Discovery, kill_chain Recon, confidence high, signature_severity Major, deployment Perimeter, network_mode plain, cve none, poc_ref tests/poc/9170005_phpinfo-probe/poc.sh, tag exposure, created_at 2026_05_22, updated_at 2026_05_22, author huntingyuk; sid:9170005; rev:1;)

description.attack: Penyerang nge-probe halaman debug `phpinfo()` yang nggak sengaja ke-publish (`/phpinfo.php`, `/info.php`, `/test.php`, `/_profiler/phpinfo` Symfony). Standar scanner recon — 48 hit di 3 pcap MTA scan-and-probe.
description.impact: Bocornya konfigurasi PHP penuh: versi, ekstensi, environment vars (sering termasuk DB credentials, API keys, secret JWT), path absolut server — bahan recon untuk serangan lanjutan tepat sasaran.
description.detects: Request ke salah satu path probe canonical phpinfo (`/phpinfo.php`/`/info.php`/`/test.php`/`/_profiler/phpinfo`/`/debug.php`).

rules.msg: WEB Exposure - Symfony _profiler / Laravel _ignition / Rails /rails/info debug-page probe [high]
rules.raw: alert http any any -> any any (msg:"WEB Exposure - Symfony _profiler / Laravel _ignition / Rails /rails/info debug-page probe [high]"; flow:established,to_server; http.uri.raw; content:"_profiler"; nocase; fast_pattern; pcre:"/\/(?:_profiler(?:\/|\?|$)|_ignition\/(?:execute-solution|health-check)|rails\/info(?:\/(?:properties|routes))?(?:\/|\?|$))/i"; classtype:attempted-recon; metadata: asset_category web-modern, owasp A05-Security-Misconfiguration, attack_target Server, mitre_tactic_id TA0007, mitre_tactic_name Discovery, mitre_technique_id T1083, mitre_technique_name File-and-Directory-Discovery, kill_chain Recon, confidence high, signature_severity Major, deployment Perimeter, network_mode plain, cve none, poc_ref tests/poc/9170006_framework-debug-probe/poc.sh, tag exposure, created_at 2026_05_22, updated_at 2026_05_22, author huntingyuk; sid:9170006; rev:1;)

description.attack: Penyerang nge-probe halaman debug framework yang nggak sengaja ke-expose ke production: Symfony Web Profiler `/_profiler`, Laravel Ignition `/_ignition/execute-solution` (CVE-2021-3129), Rails `/rails/info/routes`. Standar scanner recon.
description.impact: Bocornya routes/source-paths/DB-queries/env-vars → bahan recon serangan lanjutan; Ignition `execute-solution` = RCE pre-auth (Laravel debug).
description.detects: Request ke salah satu canonical debug path (`/_profiler[/*]`, `/_ignition/execute-solution`, `/_ignition/health-check`, `/rails/info`, `/rails/info/properties`, `/rails/info/routes`).

description.attack: Penyerang nge-probe halaman `/server-status` atau `/server-info` (Apache mod_status / mod_info) yang nggak sengaja aktif di production. Halaman ini ke-leak tabel worker process, URL request masuk, IP internal, config vhost.
description.impact: Bocornya struktur internal server Apache + traffic real-time (URL+IP) → bahan recon serangan lanjutan + privacy untuk klien.

rules.raw: alert http any any -> any any (msg:"WEB Exposure - dependency-manifest probe (composer/package/yarn/bower/Gemfile/pom/gradle) [high]"; flow:established,to_server; http.uri.raw; content:"composer.json"; nocase; fast_pattern; pcre:"/\/(?:composer\.(?:json|lock)|package(?:-lock)?\.json|yarn\.lock|bower\.json|Gemfile(?:\.lock)?|pom\.xml|build\.gradle(?:\.kts)?)(?:[\?\#\s\x00]|$)/i"; classtype:attempted-recon; metadata: asset_category web-modern, owasp A05-Security-Misconfiguration, attack_target Server, mitre_tactic_id TA0007, mitre_tactic_name Discovery, mitre_technique_id T1083, mitre_technique_name File-and-Directory-Discovery, kill_chain Recon, confidence high, signature_severity Major, deployment Perimeter, network_mode plain, cve none, poc_ref tests/poc/9170008_dep-manifest-probe/poc.sh, tag exposure, created_at 2026_05_23, updated_at 2026_05_23, author huntingyuk; sid:9170008; rev:1;)

description.attack: Penyerang nge-probe file dependency-manifest yang nggak sengaja ke-publish ke web root: `composer.json` (PHP), `package.json`/`package-lock.json` (Node.js), `yarn.lock`, `bower.json`, `Gemfile`/`Gemfile.lock` (Ruby), `pom.xml`/`build.gradle` (Java). Standar scanner recon.
description.impact: Bocornya daftar dependency + versi → bahan recon supply-chain attack (cari versi vulnerable yang ke-load app korban) + kadang ke-leak script command + author info di dalam.
description.detects: Request ke salah satu canonical manifest path (`/composer.{json,lock}`, `/package(-lock)?.json`, `/yarn.lock`, `/bower.json`, `/Gemfile(.lock)?`, `/pom.xml`, `/build.gradle`).
